statement: Nightmare Amarok needs 4000 accuracy for 5% hit chance and 12000 accuracy for 100% hit chance.
Nightmare Amarok has 100 million HP so bring enough damage to finish in reasonable time.
Bring enough defense or food since his damage is about 4x higher than on Chaotic difficulty.
Walk up to the door and click it and use the arrows to select Nightmare difficulty.
Entering requires 30 keys every attempt whether or not you kill the boss.
Amarok has two fireball types: a spray of many and a few that randomly target the ground at your position.
Sword swing slash hits everything on the platform; avoid it by jumping into the pit.
Uppercut on the upper platform is his highest damage attack.
Standing far enough back with a ranged character avoids most uppercut damage.
Rocket punch locks on but target is locked once the arm swells so you can dodge it then.
Stomp creates a line of spikes that damage you and summons all spike traps on the ground at once.
Shield Totem creates a shield where you cannot do more than 10 damage per swing.
Healing Totems only start spawning after he is at 50% HP and heal quite a bit.
If damage is insufficient run up the platforms and kill the totems to continue the fight.
Primary drops are Chaotic Slabs and coins.
Topaz drop is fairly useless on Nightmare bosses.
Radiant Amarok Card gives weapon power bonus; at 4-star it gives 15 additional weapon power.
Radiant Amarok Backstabber wings give base 50 defense plus 10% additional defense misc bonus.
Among the best ways to get wings and the only way for free-to-play players.
Radiant Amarok Backstabber Wings drop about 1 in 1000 so expect several kills.
